name: Leo
typeSystem: Static, strong, Rust-inspired type system specialised for describing arithmetic circuits: every operation must be expressible as a circuit over a finite field, so the compiler restricts and checks types accordingly (fixed-size integers, records, no unbounded loops or recursion).
runtime: Leo compiles to Aleo Instructions for the Aleo VM. leo run evaluates the off-chain circuit locally without generating a proof; leo execute generates an execution proof and transaction, which can then be broadcast for network verification and on-chain finalization.

runtimes.name: Aleo VM
runtimes.role: Executes Aleo Instructions compiled from Leo; execution proofs can be generated locally and are verified by the network when a transaction is broadcast.

compilers.name: leo build
compilers.role: Compiles Leo source to Aleo Instructions; proof and transaction generation is performed separately by leo execute.

concurrencyModel: N/A (circuit-based; a program describes a single deterministic computation to be proved, not a running concurrent process).
